title: Bypass use perfection tutorial in bio
features: First, activate the main feature in the menu. Then switch to the character you want to use. It works with all characters. After that, you need to attack and use abilities. If the Ultimate bar starts going up, that means it’s already working, and you can farm your Ultimate and kill people.
script:
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://sirius.menu/rayfield"))()

local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "hellooooo",
    LoadingTitle = "by iniciante_513"
})

local Tab = Window:CreateTab("bypass and kill")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Ativo = false

local function PegarJogadorAleatorio()
    local Lista = {}

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer 
        and p.Character 
        and p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            table.insert(Lista, p)
        end
    end

    if #Lista > 0 then
        return Lista[math.random(1, #Lista)]
    end
end

Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "use perfection...",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Callback = function(valor)
        Ativo = valor

        while Ativo do
            local Alvo = PegarJogadorAleatorio()

            if Alvo and Alvo.Character then
                local MeuChar = LocalPlayer.Character
                local MeuHRP = MeuChar and MeuChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local AlvoHRP = Alvo.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if MeuHRP and AlvoHRP then
                    -- fica colado atrás do jogador
                    local Tempo = 0.01
                    local Inicio = tick()

                    while tick() - Inicio < Tempo and Ativo do
                        MeuHRP.CFrame = AlvoHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                        task.wait()
                    end
                end
            end

            task.wait()
        end
    end
})
